name: Ulysses S. Grant
bio: The former president and Union commander of the Civil War appeared in the Cow Boy as the subject of national news. In February 1884 the paper hoped reports that his injuries would leave him on crutches were wrong, and from March 1885 it followed his illness week by week, reporting cancer, swings between decline and improvement, and hopes that he would live to finish his war history. It reported his death at Mt. McGregor on July 23, 1885, came out against his burial in New York, and in December 1885 scoffed at how little had been raised for a planned $1,000,000 monument.
